arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. CP boat 122 W, shaft 196 W (test, may be 10-25 pct off). Start hot: 161 W boat, 254 W shaft, rate 71. Leg 1 has push_along -0.35 (against). Aim: settle near CP by min 3, hold even effort, save reserve for last 1000 m, finish sprint ~ last 500-800 m. Check pod vs boat reserve agreement for current/drag errors.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus course-fitted current; strongly negative = extra drag (weed on rudder) not current

arguments.message: speed lost vs pod power beyond current: check rudder weed/drag

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.08 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 200 and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: still well above shaft CP after start phase
pod reserve under 30 pct with far to go

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w < 0.88 * cp_shaft_w and elapsed_s > 240 and remaining_m > 600
arguments.message: shaft power sagging well below CP

text: no cue: start phase, letting the paddler settle; set watches for drag (rudder weed), over-CP after start, low pod reserve, effort sag.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, settle into your long race rhythm now

Min 4 (710 m): still above CP (shaft 213 vs 196, boat 134 vs 122); pod reserve 35 pct, boat 25 pct, falling fast. Cued ease (no pace target: current flips each leg so ground pace targets mislead). Check next wake: shaft should be ~195-200. If CP looks underestimated (no fade while reserve near 0), consider set_critical_power.

text: Cued ease: still 8 pct above CP at min 4 with reserve 25-35 pct and 7.3 km to go.

arguments.message: pod reserve under 12 pct with far to go

text: no cue: ease is taking hold (shaft 211 to 204, near sustainable 198); lowered reserve watch to 12 pct.

arguments.text: Back off now, breathe, smooth strokes, long race left

Min 7.9 (1466 m): ease at min 4 barely held (shaft 205-211 vs CP 196, no fade). Pod reserve 11 pct, boat 0. Paddler: 10/10, really hurting -> test CP looks right, NOT underestimated. Cued ease again. Want shaft ~185-195 for a few min to refill, then hold ~196-198. If shaft stays >205 next wake, cue ease again. Leg 2 current helps (+0.36); legs alternate.

arguments.condition: shaft_power_w > 1.03 * cp_shaft_w and w_bal_pod_frac < 0.25 and elapsed_s > 200 and remaining_m > 1200
arguments.message: shaft above CP with low pod reserve, far from finish

text: Cued ease: pod reserve 11 pct, boat 0, paddler says 10/10 hurting at 1.5 km of 8; tightened over-CP watch.

arguments.text: Drop the rate a little, lighter strokes, recover for two minutes

Min 9.6 (1836 m): two ease cues NOT followed; shaft still 208 vs CP 196, pod reserve 1 pct, fade now -3.5 pct and speed through water falling -> blow-up risk. Tried rate_down cue instead. Next wake: if shaft still >200, try a different ask (hold with words about pacing) or ask_paddler; avoid ground-pace targets (current flips each leg, ~0.35 m/s).

text: Cued rate_down: ease cues ignored, reserve empty and fade starting at 1.8 km; trying a different, concrete ask.

arguments.text: Quick back-stroke, clear the rudder, then settle back in

arguments.name: eff_ratio
arguments.description: share of pod shaft power reaching the boat (30-s means); step up after rudder clear = weed was there

arguments.text: Min 12.6 (2362 m): boat power / shaft power fell from ~0.60-0.64 (min 5-8) to ~0.56 (min 10.6 on), then flat; speed at same rate -3 pct. Pod reserve 0 for 3 min yet shaft 208-216 held; paddler still 10/10 hurting. Suspect weed on rudder (step-and-stay drag) -> cued clear_rudder at 12.6. CHECK eff_ratio next wake: back to ~0.60 = weed cleared; still ~0.56 = tired blade or pod drift, then go back to ease cues (3 ease/rate cues so far mostly ignored).

text: Cued clear_rudder: share of shaft power reaching the boat dropped about 7 pct and stayed down (weed-like); will check eff_ratio next wake.

arguments.message: check eff_ratio / speed after rudder clear (back-stroke now out of the 30-s means)

text: no cue: speed drop is the rudder-clear back-stroke inside the 30-s means; timed watch at 14.6 min to judge whether the drag is gone.

arguments.text: Rudder clear, boat running fast again. Hold this, no harder.

arguments.message: share of shaft power reaching the boat down to weed level again (clean ~0.60, weed ~0.56)

arguments.text: Min 14.6 (2688 m): WEED CONFIRMED and cleared: eff_ratio (boat/shaft power) back from 0.56 to 0.60, fade -5 -> -2 pct. Watch weed_again fires if ratio < 0.555 for 45 s -> cue clear_rudder again. Pacing: shaft 207-215 held ~10 min, pod reserve 0 since min 10, no power decline yet -> true shaft CP may be ~205-210 (test 196). Paddler says 10/10 (twice). Cued hold (no harder). If still ~207 with no fade by min 18, set_critical_power cp_shaft ~205.

text: Cued hold: rudder clear (power share back to 0.60), paddler holding ~208 W; added weed-recurrence watch.

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course extended by one leg, finish at 9000 m

arguments.text: Course extended one leg: finish at 9 km, 5.9 km left

Min 16.8 (3057 m): RADIO: course extended to 9000 m (9 legs). Set race distance 9000 and told paddler 5.9 km left. Just turned into leg 4 (current now ~0 / helping). Shaft eased 207 -> 198 (turn in the 30-s mean, or fatigue?). Watch for blow-up: shaft sag below ~175.

text: Set race distance to 9000 m and told paddler 5.9 km left after the committee extended the course.

arguments.text: Another quick back-stroke to clear the rudder, then same rhythm

arguments.reason: paddler has held 204-216 W shaft for 15 min (min 4-18.6), 8.6 min of it with the modelled pod reserve at 0, without any decline in shaft power; test CP 196 W cannot allow that

arguments.text: Min 18.6 (3423 m): set cp_shaft 205 (evidence: ~208 W held 15 min, pod reserve modelled 0 for 8.6 min, no power decline). Fade worsened -1.8 -> -3.9 pct since the first clear at same shaft power, eff_ratio 0.60 -> 0.58: possible new weed -> cued second clear_rudder (cheap, ~2 s). Check eff_ratio/fade at next wake: if back near 0.60 / -2 pct, weed recurs -> clear again whenever ratio drifts down. Race now 9000 m.

arguments.message: check eff_ratio / fade after second rudder clear

text: Cued second clear_rudder (fade worsening at same power) and raised shaft CP to 205 W on 15 min of held power with no decline.

arguments.reason: paddler blew up at min 19 (shaft 205 -> 174 at same rate, boat power fell with it, so real) after ~15 min near 208 W: fits CP ~200 W with a reserve ~14 pct above the test, so 205 was too high

arguments.text: Breathe, recover a minute, then we rebuild. You are doing fine.

arguments.message: pod reserve refilled above 30 pct: cue a gentle push back to ~CP

arguments.text: Min 20 (3700 m): BLOW-UP at min 19: shaft 205 -> 174 at rate 64, boat power down too (ratio 0.59, no weed). Paddler 10/10 (says the same every time: uninformative). Reset cp_shaft to 200 (2 of 3 CP changes used). Cued reassure. Plan: let them refill ~2 min, then push gently back to ~195-200 shaft (NOT above), hold to the end, sprint last ~400 m only. Watch rebuild_ready fires at pod reserve > 30 pct.

text: Cued reassure after a blow-up (shaft 205 to 174); corrected shaft CP to 200 W; watch set to cue the rebuild once reserve refills.
no cue: timed check only; power share 0.60 so rudder is clean, paddler recovering after blow-up, cue just given.

arguments.message: shaft still under 190 W after the blow-up recovery: consider a gentle push to ~200

arguments.text: Min 21.3 (3967 m): paddler rebuilding on their own (shaft 174 -> 182), pod reserve 31 pct (CP 200). Did NOT cue push: their own pacing drifts to ~208 (blew up there), a push may overshoot. Watches: slow_rebuild (shaft < 190 for 60 s after min 22.5 -> cue gentle push), over_cp_late (shaft > 206 with pod reserve < 25 pct for 90 s -> cue hold/ease). Target from here: steady ~200-202 shaft, spend reserve in the last ~500 m.

text: no cue: paddler is rebuilding unprompted (174 to 182 W) and a push risks overshooting into another blow-up; watches cover both sides.

arguments.text: Good, this is your rhythm. Hold it steady, save the kick.

Min 24.3 (4468 m, 4532 left): recovered to shaft 194-197, pod reserve 36 pct, boat reserve 62, power share 0.60 (rudder clean). Cued hold to stop the creep back to ~208 that blew them up. Sustainable now ~203. Finish plan: if pod reserve stays >30 pct, cue finish at ~600-700 m left; if it drains, at ~400 m.
